about: Bob's calendar as Winnie's store held it at 2026-10-11T00:03:50.000Z (scenario counter-another-day), from Winnie's events.db (snapshot:70b7fc8), anonymized by tools/capture-calendar.ts: titles, attendees, organizers, locations and ids replaced; times, responses, transparency, all-day flags and the family and location classes kept. Rows cover the synced span (sync at now minus 15 minutes, three days back, fourteen ahead) and the ask's window; rows starting past the sync horizon are dropped. 0 row(s) show an update after now in the snapshot. The plan's own holds are not in the rows: the snapshot postdates their release.
